technology_name: JNTBGRI's Eco-Tourism: Nature, Knowledge, and Conservation
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: The degradation of sensitive biological habitats caused by conventional high-impact tourism, and the marginalization of local traditional ecological knowledge.
description: An immersive, low-impact eco-tourism model operating across 325 acres of protected forests and wetlands, developed in partnership with Kerala Tourism Infrastructure Limited (KTIL). The initiative replaces passive sightseeing with "Biodiversity Tourism," offering guided canopy walks, thematic trails, and interactive Augmented Reality (AR) exhibits. It actively involves local communities as land stewards and storytellers, integrating Citizen Science initiatives into the visitor experience.
applications:
• Blueprint for state and national wildlife sanctuary management plans

• Sustainable hospitality and low-impact eco-resort development

• Environmental education programs for academic institutions and universities

• Integration platforms for nature-based augmented reality (AR) software
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
